## Get started

- **Try without installing:** [open the browser demo](https://MrPerfectH.github.io/Semantic-Model-Viewer/) with the synthetic Contoso Retail model, or use **Open model** for your own files.
- **VS Code:** [install from the Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=MrPerfectH.semantic-model-viewer). VS Code handles updates normally.
- **Manual VS Code installation:** download `semantic-model-viewer-<version>.vsix` from the assets below, then run **Extensions: Install from VSIX…** in VS Code.
- **Static web bundle:** `semantic-model-viewer-web-<version>.zip` contains the browser app for static hosting. It is not the Windows portable app and does not include the desktop launcher or Python server.
- **Source code archives:** these are repository snapshots. Follow the [installation guide](https://github.com/MrPerfectH/Semantic-Model-Viewer/blob/main/docs/installation.md) for repository setup.

Open a TMDL `*.SemanticModel` folder, a PBIP project folder, or `model.bim`. A `.pbix` file cannot be opened directly.
